integrity: The proof uses the exact 2026 binomial-sum formulas, a uniform local De Moivre--Laplace estimate from Stirling, geometric-tail domination, and the exponentially small palindromic correction. The bundled computation is only a regression check.
scientific_limitations: The local theorem is uniform only on bounded square-root crossing-number windows. It gives no moderate-deviation rate or full-range local estimate, and it is specific to the exact 2-bridge-knot signature formulas.
title: Central-window local limit theorem for 2-bridge knot signatures
